author: r1-O2
rationale: Hand-built grammar LM. Recurrent one-hot registers (phase incl. NP type, agreement stack of pending verb numbers, clause index) are updated by word-completion events detected in the ctx window; a prefix detector bank identifies the partial word; next-char logits are a lookup over (distribution class x prefix) computed from hand-typed word lists and hand-estimated probabilities (one modifier max per NP); eos after '.' uses a length ramp.
